title: ExtraStuff Datapack
description: An Datapack which adds some random items.
body:
# ExtraStuff  Datapack

**1.21 Support is not currenty working/planned!** Maybe someday..

## Features
- **Full Emerald Tools**
- **An Slime Double Jumper**
- **Boost Pad**
- **An Make-It-Nightomat**
- **Diamond and Iron Sense**


<details>
<summary>Using the Slime Double Jumper</summary>

To use the Slime Double Jumper, you have to
be in the air (possible with the Boost Pad) and
right klick the item, which spawns slime blocks
so you can bouce

</details>

To see the recipes you can use the **"Unlock all Recipes"** Datapack from VanillaTweaks.

## Important
_Don't forget to download both the Datapack AND Resource Pack_
